title: SafeStep Voucher Validity, Approval Limits and Online Store Terms
content:
# Voucher and Online Store Terms

The terms below govern SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program participant vouchers, the retail amount above which a redemption needs the approval of the customer's program administrator, and redemption through Corbett's online store.

| Tier | Calendar days a participant voucher stays valid after issue | Retail amount (USD) above which a redemption needs the program administrator's approval | Online store redemption available | Shipping charged to the employer per online redemption (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 30 | 150.00 | No | 9.95 |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 30 | 175.00 | Yes | 9.95 |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 45 | 200.00 | Yes | 7.95 |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 60 | 225.00 | Yes | 0.00 |
| SafeStep Premier | 60 | 250.00 | Yes | 0.00 |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 90 | 300.00 | Yes | 0.00 |

## Terms explained

- **Voucher validity** is counted in calendar days after the voucher is issued.
- **Approval limit.** The figure is a retail amount. A redemption whose retail amount is above the figure needs the approval of the customer's program administrator; "above" means greater than the figure.
- **Online store.** Participants may redeem through the online store on every tier except SafeStep Voucher Basic.
- **Shipping.** The shipping figure is charged to the employer, not to the participant, for each online redemption. From SafeStep Mobile Fitting upward it is 0.00.

## Illustrations (hypothetical retail amounts)

| Tier | Hypothetical retail amount | Above the approval limit? |
|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 180.00 | Yes, 180.00 is above 175.00 |
| SafeStep Premier | 240.00 | No, 240.00 is not above 250.00 |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 300.01 | Yes, 300.01 is above 300.00 |
